title: com.matrixmedia.stream
description: State event representing a MatrixMedia stream in a Matrix room. State key is the empty string (single-stream-per-room in v1). Schema v2: the active branch matches the fields the server actually emits (including the started_at_ms/updated_at_ms/marker_generation staleness fields), and stream end is signalled by an explicit status:'ended' terminal payload. The legacy empty-object clear written by pre-v2 servers remains accepted. Staleness rule for content-capable consumers: an 'active' marker whose updated_at_ms is older than auto_end_grace_secs + sweep interval + slack (~12 min with defaults) is suspect — reconcile via the MatrixMedia REST API before rendering live UI.

oneOf.description: Active stream. Published on stream create (marker_generation = 1) and republished on host resume (marker_generation incremented, updated_at_ms refreshed).

stream_id.description: Unique stream identifier (UUID v4, lowercase hex with dashes).

host_user_id.description: Fully-qualified Matrix user ID of the stream host (e.g. '@alice:example.org').

title.description: Human-readable stream title displayed in widgets and bot messages.

media_type.description: Primary media type of the stream.

video_config.description: Video parameters for 'video'/'screen' streams so clients can pre-configure capture before joining the SFU.

viewer_url.description: Web viewer URL for non-widget clients.

mm_server_url.description: Base URL of the MatrixMedia server managing this stream. Used by SDKs for server discovery from room state.

mm_matrix_server.description: Matrix server name hosting this MM instance (used by clients to verify federation trust before connecting to a foreign MM server).

federation_enabled.description: Whether the hosting MM server has federation enabled. Clients on another homeserver should only attempt a cross-server join when true.

participant_count.description: Participant count at publish time (host + viewers). Written once per publish; live counts come from the REST snapshot.

e2ee_enabled.description: Whether E2EE is enabled for this stream.

e2ee_key_id.description: Short identifier for the current E2EE key (first 8 bytes of SHA-256).

e2ee_key_generation.description: Monotonic generation counter for E2EE keys.

started_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the stream started.

updated_at_ms.description: Wall-clock Unix timestamp (ms) of this particular publish. Consumers treat a stale value on an 'active' marker as suspect and reconcile via REST.

marker_generation.description: Marker publish counter: 1 at create, incremented on every republish for the same stream id (host resume, terminal event). Lets consumers detect ordering.

oneOf.description: Terminal payload (schema v2). Written by the server's guaranteed finalize path on every end (host end, moderation, admin, liveness sweep). marker_generation is strictly greater than the active marker's.

stream_id.description: Stream identifier this terminal event closes.

ended_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the stream ended.

marker_generation.description: Marker publish counter at end time.

oneOf.description: Legacy cleared state (pre-v2 servers). An empty object signals that no stream is active in this room.
